regimeSub: CPI relief + negative NFP entrenches Fed hold; risk assets drift higher on goldilocks repricing.

BOK Deputy Gov Yu (Aug 11) telegraphing August hike despite US pause → USDKRW pinned at 1414 on hawkish divergence; chip-driven wage spiral forcing BOK's hand
BOJ rate path derailed by Takaichi JGB stress (Reuters Aug 10) → USDJPY 159.4 stuck as Bessent Sept hike nudge loses steam on soft US data; carry unwind risk delayed not removed
OPEC+ September output expansion caps Brent at $87 post-Hormuz normalization → energy disinflation locked in; gold $4370 fading as stagflation hedge unwinds on growth scare subsiding
